data.reason_zh: 用贝叶斯演化搜索生成MAS工作流拓扑，评估反馈驱动候选选择；但更像一次性架构搜索，非部署中持续自改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: In contrast to LLM-based candidate selection, our approach uses a graph-aware Gaussian Process and Expected Improvement to provide an explicit selection criterion during evolutionary search.
scope_support.object_quote: The approach combines evolutionary operators to generate diverse workflow graphs with Bayesian optimization to focus cost intensive evaluations on promising candidates.
scope_support.persistence_quote: On BigCodeBench, evolved architectures achieve the highest overall performance among the evaluated agent systems.
